ar: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ وَيْلٌۭ لِّكُلِّ هُمَزَةٍۢ لُّمَزَةٍ
tl: Kalla layum ba zanna fil hutamah
en: Who gathers wealth and counts it over.
Thinking that his wealth has made him immortal.
By no means. He will be thrown into the Crusher.
And what will make you realize what the Crusher is?
sw: Anadhani ya kuwa mali yake yatambakisha milele!
Na nani atakujuvya ni nini H'ut'ama?
Moto wa Mwenyezi Mungu ulio washwa.
fr: qui amasse une fortune et la compte,
Mais non! Il sera certes, jeté dans la Hutamah.
Et qui te dira ce qu'est la Hutamah?
